configure: --disable-gpl --disable-nonfree --disable-autodetect --enable-static
           --disable-shared --disable-doc --disable-debug --disable-ffplay --enable-small
           --arch=x86_64 --cc="clang -arch x86_64" --enable-cross-compile --target-os=darwin

         config.mak has !CONFIG_GPL, !CONFIG_NONFREE, !CONFIG_LIBX264,

Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-7.1.5.tar.xz (unmodified upstream).
Use: decode-only (audio extraction). Shipped as a separate executable we shell
     out to, so there is no static-linking/relinking obligation — notice + source
     offer only. Wire via HR_FFMPEG_DARWIN_SRC (HeardRight) / FFMPEG_DARWIN_SRC
